import os, sys, sqlite3, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import


def fresh():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    return c


class ImportContactsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_batch(self):
        c = fresh()
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(c, []), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})

    def test_insert_and_normalize(self):
        c = fresh()
        r = import_contacts(c, [{"email": "  A@Example.COM ", "name": "  Alice "}])
        self.assertEqual(r, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@example.com", "Alice")])

    def test_existing_counts_as_updated_even_if_unchanged(self):
        c = fresh()
        add_contact(c, "a@b.c", "Alice")
        r = import_contacts(c, [{"email": "A@B.C", "name": "Alice"}, {"email": "x@y.z", "name": "X"}])
        self.assertEqual(r, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@b.c", "Alice"), ("x@y.z", "X")])

    def test_update_name(self):
        c = fresh()
        add_contact(c, "a@b.c", "Old")
        import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b.c", "name": "New"}])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@b.c", "New")])

    def test_invalid_rows_reject_and_leave_db_unchanged(self):
        bad_batches = [
            [{"email": "ok@x.y", "name": "A"}, "not-a-dict"],
            [{"email": "ok@x.y", "name": "A"}, {"email": "p@x.y"}],
            [{"email": "ok@x.y", "name": "A"}, {"email": "p@x.y", "name": "B", "extra": 1}],
            [{"email": "ok@x.y", "name": "A"}, {"email": "a@b@c", "name": "B"}],
            [{"email": "ok@x.y", "name": "A"}, {"email": "@c", "name": "B"}],
            [{"email": "ok@x.y", "name": "A"}, {"email": "b@", "name": "B"}],
            [{"email": "ok@x.y", "name": "A"}, {"email": "a b@c.d", "name": "B"}],
            [{"email": "ok@x.y", "name": "A"}, {"email": "ab@c.d", "name": "   "}],
            [{"email": "ok@x.y", "name": "A"}, {"email": "ab@c.d", "name": 5}],
            [{"email": "ok@x.y", "name": "A"}, {"email": "ok@X.y", "name": "dup"}],
        ]
        for batch in bad_batches:
            with self.subTest(batch=batch):
                c = fresh()
                add_contact(c, "keep@x.y", "Keep")
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_contacts(c, batch)
                self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("keep@x.y", "Keep")])

    def test_db_failure_rolls_back_whole_batch(self):
        c = fresh()
        add_contact(c, "keep@x.y", "Keep")
        c.execute("CREATE TRIGGER boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'z@z.z' "
                  "BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
        c.commit()
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.DatabaseError):
            import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@a.a", "name": "A"},
                                {"email": "keep@x.y", "name": "Changed"},
                                {"email": "z@z.z", "name": "Z"}])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("keep@x.y", "Keep")])


class ApiImportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_envelope(self):
        c = fresh()
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": "a@b.c", "name": "A"}]}),
                         {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
        for bad in [None, [], {}, {"contacts": None}, {"contacts": [], "x": 1}, {"rows": []}]:
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    handle_import(c, bad)

    def test_add_still_works(self):
        c = fresh()
        self.assertEqual(handle_add(c, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"}), {"ok": True})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), [("a@b", "Alice")])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
